entities.summary: Nikola Georgiev Minchev is a Bulgarian politician. He was elected MEP at the 2024 European Parliament election. A member of the PP party, he previously served as Speaker of the National Assembly from 2021 to 2022 and Member of the National Assembly from 2021 to 2024.
